stories.title: Tennessee Titans player Jaylen Harrell 'reportedly assaulted' rideshare driver prior to Tampa crash, police say
stories.summary: Harrell remains hospitalized as of Saturday. Police say he was riding in the back of a rideshare and "reportedly assaulted the driver" as the car was in motion.

Worker injured by fallen tree limb in Brooksville: HCSO
stories.summary: Hernando County deputies are on scene of the accident.

stories.title: Courtney Campbell Causeway reopens hours after fatal crash
stories.summary: A spokesperson with Tampa Fire Rescue said one person was killed and another was transported as a trauma alert.

stories.title: Thanksgiving meal distributions, giveaways across Tampa Bay
stories.summary: For those in need, see how and where you can get free Thanksgiving supplies in your community.

stories.title: Hillsborough County deputy arrested, faces felony child abuse charge
stories.summary: The sheriff's office said Christopher Baumann Jr., 29, has been suspended without pay pending the outcome of the criminal and administrative investigation.

stories.title: Tesla caught fire on I-75 South in Hillsborough County: FHP
stories.summary: Lanes were blocked off as crews were on scene Friday afternoon, but they have since reopened.

stories.title: Former plastic surgeon Tomasz Kosowski sentenced to death for murder of Largo attorney Steven Cozzi
stories.summary: Kosowski, who represented himself throughout his trial, showed no reaction as the judge announced his fate.

stories.title: Plastic surgeon Dr. Tomasz Kosowski sentenced to death in 2023 murder of attorney
stories.summary: Kosowski was convicted of killing attorney Steven Cozzi back in 2023. Cozzi's body has never been found.

stories.title: Dengue cases surpass 600 across Tampa Bay: See county-by-county numbers
stories.summary: Florida has confirmed 651 locally acquired cases of dengue fever, with the majority reported in Hillsborough County.

stories.title: State revokes Pasco midwife’s license after ‘egregious’ conduct
stories.summary: “It is impossible not to conclude that respondent poses a serious danger to the public and must be removed from this profession," an FLDOH final order reads.

stories.title: Shuttered Tampa schools floated as potential option for temporary juvenile justice facility
stories.summary: The ideas come after the state closed the Hillsborough Regional Justice Detention Center, which is on land now slated for the Rays' planned stadium district.
